title: Planned change: recent dates read as dates, older ones unchanged
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has an unused credit memo created today.
  • Customer X has a past-due invoice dated more than a week ago.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Open customer X's group.
  4. Read the credit memo's Date.
  5. Read the invoice's Date.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • PRD v12, S2-R1a, quoted: “Date and Due Date show plain dates on screen, for example "Nov 4, 2026". The PDF and the CSV keep their own date formats (S3-R7a, S3-R8). They never read "Today", "Yesterday" or "2 days ago".”
  • Step 4 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): Today's date written out, for example "Nov 11, 2026", not "Today".
  • Step 5 (unchanged from before the release): The older date reads in the same form as before, for example "Nov 4, 2026".
  • Related existing case: S2-43 C1062572 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/1062572); S2-44 C1062573 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/1062573). This case checks the same planned change from the before-the-release side.

Why this matters: Dates must be comparable with QuickBooks.

SOURCE: A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S2-R1a. V1 behaviour before the change: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/utils/helpers.ts:195-217; app/src/utils/helpers.ts:210-217.

This is the expected behaviour as per the A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S2-R1a, for epic SV-11315; the V1 behaviour it changes is recorded in AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-093). Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
